SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
PASSAIC COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000196
DOCKET NO. F 002756 25 CTL# 163142
PLAINTIFF – WILMINGTON SAVINGS FUNDS SOCIETY, FSB NOT IN ITS INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY BUT SOLELY AS TRUSTEE OF ARUGULA FUNDING TITLING TRUST
DEFENDANTS- ROBERT MENENDEZ, ET ALS.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 26th DAY OF May 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Commissioner’s Meeting Room, Room 220 Administration Building, 401 Grand Street, Paterson, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the of Clifton, County of Passaic and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: Tax lot 58 in Block 31.01
Dimensions of lot: 60 feet wide by 83 feet long
Nearest cross street: Paulison Avenue
Estimated upset bid amount: $88,000.00 plus any additional sums as ordered by the court
Occupancy status: Owner Occupied
The sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice through publication
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
2026 Qtr 1 Due: 02/01/2026 $2,068.54 OPEN
2026 Qtr 2 Due: 05/01/2026 $2,068.54 OPEN
Sewer: Clifton City 900 Clifton Ave. Clifton, NJ 07013 973-470-5833 Acct: 101824 0 07/01/2025-12/31/2025
$309.33 OPEN PLUS PENALTY $309.33 OPEN PLUS PENALTY
WATER: Passaic Valley Water Comm. 1525 Main Ave. Clifton, NJ 07011 973-340-4300 Acct: 0191185-016976 To: 01/23/2026 $761.29 OPEN PLUS PENALTY
Prospective purchasers are on notice that there is a prior mortgage to mortgage electronic registration systems, inc., acting solely as nominee for countrywide home loans inc in the original amount of $427,000.00 recorded on 01/15/2005 in book 6329 at page 68 with the Passaic county register/clerk. the mortgage was assigned to bac home loans servicing lp f/k/a countrywide home loans servicing, l.p by assignment of mortgage dated 09/25/2009 an recorded 11/13/2009 in book as298 page 80 with the Passaic county clerk/register. the mortgage was further assigned to federal national mortgage association by assignment of mortgage dated 1/29/2028 and recorded 3/5/2018 in book as603 page 93 with the Passaic county clerk/register. the mortgage was further assigned to mtglq investors, lp by assignment of mortgage dated 2/16/2018 and recorded 3/5/2018 in book as603 page 95 with the Passaic county clerk/register. the mortgage was further assigned to legacy mortgage asset trust 2017-rpl2 by assignment of mortgage dated 9/19/2018 and recorded 3/19/2019 in book as651 page 203 with the Passaic county clerk/register.
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
12 HELEN Place Clifton, NJ 07011
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Passaic County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Passaic County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $78,891.51 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Thomas Adamo
SHERIFF
Advertised in the Passaic County Sheriff Website
DATED: May 4, 2026
RAS, PLLC
130 Clinton Road
Suite 202
Fairfield, NJ 07004
973-575-0707
